import builtins
from typing import NoReturn

import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Print one log line to stdout in the form ``[level] message``.

    Console output only: this function must not open, create, or write
    any file.
    """
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_prints_formatted_line(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "service started")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[INFO] service started\n"


def test_log_line_preserves_level_case(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warn", "disk at 90%")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[warn] disk at 90%\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_does_not_touch_filesystem(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    def _no_open(*args: object, **kwargs: object) -> NoReturn:
        raise AssertionError("log_line must not open files")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", _no_open)
    log_line("ERROR", "boom")
    assert capsys.readouterr().out == "[ERROR] boom\n"
